class.name: IfcFlowMeter
class.brief_description: A flow meter is a device that is used to measure the flow rate in a system. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcFlowMeter defines the occurrence of any flow meter; common information about flow meter types is handled by IfcFlowMeterType .
